headline: NFL Star Jalen Hurts Funds $600K Air Conditioning Project
meta_description: Three years after witnessing a Philadelphia school close due to lack of air conditioning, Jalen Hurts donated $600,000 to cool Northeast High's auditorium.
summary_short: Jalen Hurts has donated $600,000 to air condition Northeast High's auditorium in Philadelphia, fulfilling a commitment inspired by witnessing school closures.
body:
Jalen Hurts has donated $600,000 to air condition Northeast High's auditorium in Philadelphia—a pledge born from witnessing the school's struggles three years earlier when it was forced to close due to lack of air conditioning.

The donation addresses a persistent problem that affects student learning and school operations. Hurts's gift will directly improve conditions at Northeast High, helping ensure students have a climate-controlled space for assemblies and events.

His contribution reflects a broader commitment to supporting educational infrastructure in his community, turning a difficult observation into meaningful action that benefits current and future students.
quick_facts: Jalen Hurts donated $600,000 for air conditioning
Northeast High School in Philadelphia is the recipient
Project focuses on the school's auditorium
Donation inspired by school closure three years prior
